name: Salem
story_so_far: I survived a shipwreck and washed up on this island with four strangers. Khalid died of hunger and exhaustion on Day 8, proving that weakness is a death sentence. I have prioritized my own survival, maintaining a personal stockpile. Noura is reliable and secures her own supplies. Faisal is a constant burden due to his twisted ankle, and I suffered a similar injury on Day 10 which nearly depleted my reserves. Now that I am mobile, I am focused on replenishing my stash, which currently stands at 5 pieces of food. Reem has claimed her ankle is better and wants to help, but I remain skeptical of her words until she brings in real supplies. I have learned that mobility is my greatest asset and that an injured person is merely a drain on resources.

Noura.note: She is reliable and understands the necessity of self-sufficiency.

Faisal.note: He is a drain on resources and his injury makes him a liability.

Reem.note: She claims to be helpful now, but I am waiting to see if her actions match her words.

Khalid.note: His death was a result of his own inability to remain strong.

plans: I intend to head back to the jungle tomorrow to forage for more food. My current stash of 5 is still too low for my comfort, and I need to increase my reserves while my strength is up.

diary.text: What a nightmare of a day. I survived the wreck, but I'm stuck on this beach with four strangers. At least I managed to find some food and wood for myself so I'm not starving tonight. I need to keep my strength up if I'm going to make it off this rock. I'll keep my eyes on the horizon for any ships.

Today was more productive for me, at least. While Khalid was busy trying to pivot our strategy toward wood, I managed to secure a decent amount for myself. Noura is out of commission with a twisted ankle, which might make things more difficult for the group's morale. I'm glad I kept my food stash decent; I can't afford to rely on anyone else's luck. I need to keep gathering my own supplies if I want to survive this.

Today was relatively quiet, but I managed to add one more piece of wood to my stash. Noura and Reem found some food, but it doesn't change the fact that I need to maintain my own reserves. I ate tonight, so my food count is dropping. I need to find more food soon if I want to keep my strength up. Watching the horizon remains my priority.

Today was a bit more productive for my personal stash, which is what matters. I managed to find another piece of food and two more pieces of wood while wandering the jungle. However, the group dynamic is shifting for the worse; Khalid, who was actually being useful, is now injured with a twisted ankle just like Noura. It seems like this island is just taking people out one by one. I need to keep my reserves high because I can't rely on a group that's falling apart.

Today was largely unproductive, which is frustrating. I spent time in the jungle but found nothing new, while Noura actually managed to find some food despite her ankle. With Faisal and Reem both gone to the reef, the camp feels even more unstable. I ate my portion tonight, so my reserves are dipping again. I need to find a more efficient way to secure food before my stash runs dry.

Today was better than yesterday, at least for my own stomach. I managed to find two pieces of food in the jungle, which keeps my personal stash at a decent level. The camp is becoming a joke; now Faisal is injured too, joining Noura and Khalid in the useless pile. It feels like everyone is breaking down while I'm the only one actually securing supplies. I need to keep my eyes on the horizon and my hands on my food.

Today was a productive day for my stomach, even if the rest of the camp is a mess. I spent my time in the jungle and managed to secure two more pieces of food, bringing my personal stash up to a safe level. While Reem and Noura scraped together crumbs, I actually prioritized my own survival. The group is increasingly pathetic with three people unable to move, but as long as I have my reserves, I can wait for a ship.

Everything is falling apart. Khalid is dead, and honestly, his constant worrying didn't help anyone. With Reem injured now, the group is basically just a collection of mouths to feed. I managed to secure two more pieces of food today, which is the only reason I'm not in the same position he was in. I need to stay focused on my own stash; there's no point in carrying dead weight anymore.

Today was another day of watching the others struggle while I focus on my own survival. Noura is finally starting to understand the importance of keeping her own supplies safe, which is the only sensible thing anyone has said lately. Faisal actually attempted to go to the reef, but he's still mostly a burden. I managed to eat tonight, so my personal stash is still holding up at 6 pieces of food. I must keep finding more before the others realize how much I've actually secured.

Everything has gone wrong. I woke up with a badly twisted ankle, and for the first time, I am as useless as the others. I couldn't forage or move at all today, forced to just sit and wait. I had to dip into my stash to eat, so my reserves are dropping. If I can't walk tomorrow, I'm in serious trouble.

My ankle is finally feeling better, and I managed to rest enough to feel human again. I ate one of my rations tonight, so my stash has dropped to four. Faisal and Noura managed to find a little food, which is more than I could do while I was hobbling around. I need to get back to foraging as soon as possible to replenish what I've used. I can't afford to let these people see how much I'm actually relying on my reserves.

Finally, my ankle is functional enough to move again. I managed to get to the jungle and scavenge a little bit, though it wasn't nearly enough. My stash is down to 4 pieces of food, and that scares me. I can't afford to be immobile like I was two days ago. I need to focus entirely on replenishing my supplies before I run out.

Today was a step in the right direction. I managed to scavenge some food at the camp and again in the jungle, bringing my stash back up slightly. Noura is also finding things, which means she isn't a complete drain on the group's energy. I'm feeling stronger now that my ankle is healed, and I can finally focus on my own replenishment. I need to keep this momentum going before my reserves dip too low again.

Today was largely a waste of time in the jungle. I went out there hoping to find something substantial, but I ended up doing nothing of substance. Reem claims her ankle is better and wants to help, but I'll believe it when I see her actually bringing back food, not just a single piece of wood. My stash is sitting at 5, which is uncomfortably low. I need to be more aggressive with my foraging tomorrow.

Today was productive enough. I managed to scavenge another piece of food in the jungle, bringing my stash back up to six before I ate tonight. I also secured more wood, which is essential for staying prepared. Reem was out in the jungle too, gathering wood; I'll be watching to see if she actually contributes something useful soon. For now, I am stable, but I cannot let my guard down.
